name: Noir Quote
tagline: Letterboxed, grainy and slow. Italic serif words drift in out of the dark.
description: Cinematic noir look for trailers, quotes and brand films: letterbox bars, animated film grain, a slowly drifting warm light in the dark, and italic serif words that fade in one at a time from a soft blur. The preview is a quote card with an attribution and a tracked title.
textAnimations: slow scale settle on attribution and title (1.08–1.12 → 1)

rhythm.notes: Nothing moves faster than 1s. Let the last word breathe before the fade.

guide:
- Look only: build the user's own subject in this visual language; don't reuse the example's scene.
- Always keep 130px black letterbox bars and a film-grain layer (SVG turbulence, ~16% opacity, stepped drift) on top of everything.
- Near-monochrome: deep blacks, smoky greys and one soft warm light source, a beam or glow drifting a few degrees. Show the subject in silhouette or low-key light emerging from the dark.
- Words fade in individually: opacity 0, y 14, blur 6px → sharp, 1.1s, 0.22s stagger, power1.inOut.
- Type: italic Playfair Display at ~82px, centred, at most two lines; small attributions or labels under a thin 140px rule in tracked uppercase Cormorant Garamond.
- Everything is slow: nothing faster than 1s, slow cross-fades (1s) or fades through black, slow scale settles (1.08–1.12 → 1) on titles and images.
- Animate transforms only for titles; letter-spacing tweens stutter in frame-by-frame renders.
- Avoid bounces, saturated colour, hard graphic shapes and busy layouts.
example: The preview is a cinematic quote card: an italic quote drifts in word by word under a light beam, then an attribution and a widely tracked title. Don't copy this scene unless asked.
